query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) AND n.granularity='item' WITH n,EXISTS { MATCH (n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section) } AS isLinked RETURN count(n)=sum(CASE WHEN isLinked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS allLinked
